coordinates: Native upright source pixels with the origin at upper left. East facade X increases north and the two flanking masonry faces share Y=0. Z=0 is the pavement seam at the wing ends.

span.method: The GIS owner simplifies the southern corner. Both cut corners are present in the photographs and described in the inventory. Subtract the measured northern cut from the simplified street edge to estimate the width between the two main pilasters.

edge_references.note: Scale is taken from the original site, vertical scale from the near-frontal view corrected for its small side-to-side variation. Both values are estimates. Cornice is the top of the moulding between storeys one and two.
